title: Version floor: effective minimum FileMaker version
description: Features in scope that require a NEWER FileMaker than their file declares as its minimum (SaXML AddAction/Minimum → FileOptionsCatalog.Min_Version). Three axes: script steps (fm_spec step_compat.originated_in_version_num), built-in functions (functions.origin_version_num) and script triggers (script_triggers.since_version_num, joined over the SaXML slot id). Comparison always runs on the numeric key, never on the version string ('8.5' sorts before '19.0' lexically). A feature the reference carries no version for is not counted — no published statement is not 'old'; '6.0 or earlier' is read as a floor, not an exact version. The summary also answers the neutral question: the effective minimum version of the whole scope, and how many files carry no readable declaration.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: The declared minimum version is what the file promises; it does not follow the features that were added later. A file that promises FileMaker 16 but uses a step introduced in 19 misleads everyone who plans a rollout, a client version or a server upgrade — and the mismatch only surfaces when an older client actually opens it.
rule.remediation: Decide which way the mismatch goes: either raise the declared minimum to the effective floor, or replace the features that push it (the findings name them per file, highest requirement first).

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Features in scope that require a newer FileMaker version than their file declares
